experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume_overlap
experiment.description: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume (step 4) with patch_length changed from 7 to 14 (patch_stride stays 7, so patches now overlap 50%, 9 patches instead of 10) -- standard PatchTST practice uses overlapping patches (stride < length); this branch's non-overlapping convention was untested. Everything else identical to step 4: 20 epochs, flat LR=6e-4, plain RevIN MSE loss, no directional term -- isolated from the training-duration/loss-engineering levers already ruled out.

loss_weights.note: unweighted -- single RevIN-normalized MSE over the 4 OHLC channels
